Become a Member Explore the Directory

Mission Statement

The Invest USA Committee is dedicated to advancing Taiwan–U.S. investment ties by helping Taiwan companies establish and expand operations in the United States. We bring together U.S. state partners, Taiwan and U.S. government-affiliated organizations, industry experts, professional service providers, and business networks to provide coordinated support and practical guidance. By connecting companies with the right resources at every stage of their investment journey, we help them successfully launch, grow, and build a long-term presence in the U.S. market.

Learn more about the committee →

How the Committee Helps Taiwan Companies Invest

Practical Support at Every Stage

  • Connect you with vetted legal, tax, accounting, and site-selection professionals through our Member Directory
  • Introduce you to U.S. state Economic Development Organizations (EDOs) and government-affiliated partners
  • Provide practical guidance on structuring, financing, workforce, and compliance through our How to Invest resource
  • Share data and trends on where Taiwan companies are investing via our Taiwan FDI Map
  • Coordinate participation in investment seminars, delegations, and networking events

Where to Start

Whether you're exploring the U.S. market for the first time or expanding an existing footprint, the Committee can help you find the right partners and information for your stage of investment.

About Us

Mission, activities & members

Mission Statement

The Invest USA Committee is dedicated to advancing Taiwan–U.S. investment ties by helping Taiwan companies establish and expand operations in the United States. We bring together U.S. state partners, Taiwan and U.S. government-affiliated organizations, industry experts, professional service providers, and business networks to provide coordinated support and practical guidance. By connecting companies with the right resources at every stage of their investment journey, we help them successfully launch, grow, and build a long-term presence in the U.S. market.

What We Do

  • Serve as a central platform connecting Taiwan companies with U.S. investment resources
  • Bring together U.S. state economic development offices, government-affiliated organizations, and professional service providers
  • Share practical information and resources to support U.S. investment planning
  • Foster collaboration among organizations supporting Taiwan–U.S. investment

Who We Convene

  • U.S. state and regional economic development organizations
  • Government-affiliated organizations supporting cross-border investment
  • Professional service providers with U.S. market expertise
  • Industry associations and business networks
  • Taiwan companies exploring or expanding U.S. operations
  • Universities, research institutions, and innovation partners

Invest

Why Taiwan companies should invest in the United States

The United States Is the World's Largest Market

🌎Largest single market — $29 trillion GDP and 330 million consumers
💰Deepest capital markets in the world — access to equity, debt, and venture funding
🎓Highly skilled, mobile workforce — output per hour over 30% above the OECD average
💡Global center for innovation — world-class universities and R&D partnerships
🏛️Strong legal protections and IP enforcement environment
🏭Proximity to major advanced manufacturing clusters — Arizona, Texas, Ohio, and more
🔗Supply chain resilience and geopolitical diversification away from China
🎁CHIPS Act, IRA, and other federal & state incentive programs offering billions in grants and tax credits

The U.S. hosts more inward FDI than any other country — $5.7 trillion in total FDI stock as of 2024 — and Asia-Pacific companies account for over 20% of that total. 2025 was a record year for Taiwan investment in the U.S., both by number of projects and total dollar value.

Invest

Top 10 things to know about successfully investing in the U.S.

Source: SelectUSA Investor Guide, U.S. Department of Commerce — trade.gov/selectusa-investor-guide

For each item, click the source to learn more, or click the directory link to find a qualified professional.

01Choose the Right Business Structure

The SelectUSA Investor Guide identifies business structure as one of the first critical decisions for foreign investors, covering LLC, C-Corp, S-Corp, and branch office structures. The right choice depends on your tax situation, liability preferences, and long-term goals.

SelectUSA — Business structureMember directory: Legal ServicesMember directory: Accounting, Audit & Tax Services

02Understand U.S. Tax Obligations at Every Level

The U.S. has a layered tax system spanning federal, state, and local levels. Working with a qualified CPA on corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and applicable tax treaty provisions is essential before establishing your entity.

SelectUSA — TaxationMember directory: Accounting, Audit & Tax Services

03Research Federal and State Incentive Programs

SelectUSA offers a Federal Programs & Incentives Database alongside a State Business Incentives Database. Understanding programs early — including CHIPS Act, IRA, and Opportunity Zones — can significantly reduce capital costs.

SelectUSA — Incentives Databases (Stats)SelectUSA — Fact SheetsMember directory: Accounting, Audit & Tax Services

04Connect with State Economic Development Organizations (EDOs)

SelectUSA works with companies and EDOs to address questions involving federal regulations and activities related to investments. Engaging EDOs early is critical as incentive programs often require advance notification.

SelectUSA — EDO servicesMember directory: Government & Public Sector Organizations

05Plan Your Workforce Strategy

The U.S. workforce is skilled, innovative, and mobile — output per hour is more than 30% above the OECD average. State and local governments actively help companies understand labor regulations and workforce incentives.

SelectUSA — Workforce Data AnalysisMember directory: Human Resources & Talent Solutions

06Secure U.S. Banking and Financial Infrastructure Early

The United States hosts the most developed financial markets in the world. Opening accounts for a foreign-owned entity takes longer than expected — start early and work with banks that have Taiwan relationships.

SelectUSA — Financial marketsMember directory: Banking & Financial Services

07Develop a Capital and Funding Strategy

The SelectUSA Investor Guide covers raising capital including U.S. capital markets, venture capital, private equity, and tax considerations. U.S. capital investors are typically not involved in day-to-day management.

SelectUSA — Raising capitalMember directory: Banking & Financial ServicesMember directory: Accounting, Audit & Tax Services

08Build Your U.S. Customer Base and Business Development Approach

The SelectUSA Investor Guide addresses customer acquisition best practices including B2B and B2C marketing, internet marketplaces, and public relations tactics for companies new to the U.S. market.

SelectUSA — Customer acquisitionMember directory: Business Consulting & Market Entry

09Understand Federal Procurement and Regulatory Compliance

The SelectUSA Investor Guide covers Build America, Buy American, Trade Agreements, and the Berry Amendment. Companies in semiconductors, environmental technology, or advanced manufacturing should also assess CFIUS requirements early.

SelectUSA — Federal procurementMember directory: Legal Services

10Use SelectUSA as Your Single Point of Contact

SelectUSA serves as a single point of contact at the federal level. Since inception, SelectUSA has facilitated more than US$64 billion in investment, creating and/or retaining over 86,000 U.S. jobs.

SelectUSA Investor GuideSelectUSA Investment Summit

Source: SelectUSA Investor Guide, U.S. Department of Commerce, International Trade Administration. Available at trade.gov/selectusa-investor-guide.

Attract Taiwanese Investment

For U.S. state economic development organizations (EDOs) seeking Taiwanese partners and investors

Why Taiwan Is a Strategic Investment Partner for the United States

  • Taiwan and the United States have strengthened economic cooperation through the U.S.–Taiwan Agreement on Trade & Investment, supporting closer commercial engagement and long-term investment collaboration.
  • Taiwan is a global leader in advanced manufacturing, with internationally competitive strengths in semiconductors, AI supply chains, robotics, drones, HealthTech, and food manufacturing. Taiwan investment brings advanced manufacturing capabilities, technology expertise, and resilient supply chain partnerships that support innovation and high-quality job creation across the United States.
  • Taiwan is one of the fastest-growing sources of foreign direct investment in the U.S., with 2025 marking a record year by both number of projects and total dollar value.
  • Taiwan investment is diversifying rapidly away from China: in 2010, over 83% of Taiwan's outbound investment went to China; by 2025, China accounts for less than 1%, with the United States now Taiwan's #1 destination.

Under the U.S.–Taiwan Agreement on Trade & Investment (U.S. Department of Commerce, January 2026): Taiwanese semiconductor and technology enterprises have committed to at least $250 billion in new direct investments to build advanced semiconductor, energy, and AI production capacity in the United States, backed by at least $250 billion in Taiwan-government credit guarantees to facilitate additional investment across the full semiconductor supply chain. The two countries will also establish world-class industrial parks, positioning the U.S. as the global center for next-generation technology and advanced manufacturing.

投資美國委員會重視您的隱私，並致力於依照適用法規保護您的個人資料。本隱私聲明說明我們如何蒐集、使用、儲存及揭露您在使用本網站時所提供或產生之個人資料。

請您在使用本網站前詳細閱讀本隱私聲明。

第一條　資料蒐集之範圍

我們可能蒐集下列類型之資料：

（一）您主動提供之資料
  • 姓名、公司名稱、職稱；
  • 電子郵件地址、電話號碼、通訊地址；
  • 您透過表單、問卷、訂閱或活動報名等方式所提供之其他資訊；
  • 您向我們提出詢問或聯繫時所提供之內容。
（二）自動蒐集之資料

當您瀏覽本網站時，我們可能透過Cookie及類似技術自動蒐集下列資料：

  • IP位址及裝置資訊（如作業系統、瀏覽器類型及版本）；
  • 瀏覽頁面、瀏覽時間、點擊路徑及停留時間；
  • 造訪來源（如搜尋引擎或外部連結）；
  • 網站使用統計資料（以彙整、匿名化之方式蒐集）。

第二條　依個人資料保護法之特定目的及個人資料之類別

依中華民國個人資料保護法（以下簡稱「個資法」）及主管機關依法公告之「個人資料保護法之特定目的及個人資料之類別」，本網站蒐集、處理及利用個人資料之特定目的及可能涉及之個人資料類別說明如下：

一、特定目的

第三條　資料蒐集之目的與使用

我們蒐集個人資料之目的包括：

  • 提供、維護及改善本網站之功能與內容；
  • 回應您之詢問、提供所申請之資訊或服務；
  • 寄送您訂閱之電子報、活動通知或相關資訊；
  • 分析使用者行為以優化使用者體驗；
  • 遵守適用法律法規及回應主管機關之要求；
  • 維護本網站之安全及防止詐欺或濫用行為。

我們僅於上述蒐集目的之必要範圍內使用您的個人資料。

第四條　Cookie 及追蹤技術

4.1　Cookie之使用：本網站使用Cookie（儲存於您裝置上之小型文字檔案）以提升您的瀏覽體驗。我們使用之Cookie類型包括：

4.2　您可透過瀏覽器設定管理或拒絕Cookie；惟停用部分Cookie可能影響本網站某些功能之正常使用。

4.3　本網站可能使用Google Analytics或其他第三方分析工具蒐集使用統計，該等工具之隱私政策請參閱各服務提供者之官方聲明。

第五條　資料之揭露與共享

Invest USA Committee respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information in accordance with applicable law. This Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, store, and disclose personal information that you provide or that is generated when you use this Website.

Please read this Privacy Notice carefully before using the Website.

Article 1 — Information We Collect

We may collect the following categories of information:

A. Information You Voluntarily Provide
  • Name, company name, and job title;
  • Email address, telephone number, and mailing address;
  • Other information you provide through forms, surveys, subscriptions, or event registrations;
  • Content of inquiries or other communications you send to us.
B. Information Collected Automatically

When you browse the Website, we may automatically collect the following information through cookies and similar technologies:

  • IP address and device information (such as operating system, browser type, and version);
  • Pages visited, time of visit, click paths, and time spent on pages;
  • Referral source (such as search engines or external links);
  • Website usage statistics (collected in aggregated and anonymized form).

Article 2 — Specific Purposes and Categories of Personal Information under the Personal Information Protection Act

In accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act of the Republic of China (Taiwan) ("PDPA") and the official schedules of specific purposes and categories of personal information published by the competent authority, the specific purposes for which we collect, process, and use personal information, and the categories of personal information that may be involved, are set out below.

Article 3 — How We Use Your Information

We collect personal information for the following purposes:

  • To provide, maintain, and improve the functionality and content of the Website;
  • To respond to your inquiries and provide requested information or services;
  • To send newsletters, event notifications, or other information you have subscribed to;
  • To analyze user behavior in order to optimize the user experience;
  • To comply with applicable laws and regulations and respond to requests from competent authorities;
  • To maintain the security of the Website and prevent fraud or abuse.

We use your personal information only to the extent necessary for the above stated purposes.

Article 4 — Cookies and Tracking Technologies

4.1 Use of Cookies: The Website uses cookies (small text files stored on your device) to enhance your browsing experience. The types of cookies we use include:

Cookie TypePurpose
Essential CookiesTo maintain basic website functionality
Analytical CookiesTo collect usage statistics to improve website performance
Functional CookiesTo remember your preferences (e.g., language selection)

4.2 You may manage or decline cookies through your browser settings; however, disabling certain cookies may affect the proper functioning of some features of the Website.

4.3 The Website may use Google Analytics or other third-party analytics tools to collect usage statistics. Please refer to the privacy policies of the respective service providers for further information.

Article 5 — Disclosure and Sharing of Information

We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may disclose your personal information in the following circumstances:

  • Service Providers: We may share your information with third-party technical service providers who assist us in operating the Website. Such providers may only use your information within the scope of our instructions;
  • Legal Requirements: Where we are required to disclose information under applicable law, court order, or requests from competent authorities;
  • Protection of Legitimate Interests: Where necessary to protect the legal rights, property, or safety of Invest USA Committee or other users;
  • With Your Consent: Where you have given your prior, explicit consent.

Cross-Border Transfers: The Website is supported by systems in [*]. Your personal information may be transferred to and processed in other jurisdictions. We will take appropriate safeguards in accordance with applicable law to ensure that your information is adequately protected during any cross-border transfer.

Article 6 — Retention of Personal Information

We will retain your personal information for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by applicable law. When personal information is no longer necessary, we will securely delete or anonymize it.

Article 7 — Security

We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification, or destruction. Please note, however, that no transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be completely secure, and we cannot guarantee the absolute security of data during transmission.

Article 8 — Your Rights

Subject to applicable law, including PDPA, you have the following rights with respect to your personal information:

  • Right of Access: To inquire about and review the personal information we hold about you;
  • Right to a Copy: To request a copy of your personal information;
  • Right to Rectification: To request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal information;
  • Right to Restriction: To request that we cease collecting, processing, or using your personal information;
  • Right to Erasure: To request deletion of your personal information in certain circumstances;
  • Right to Withdraw Consent: To withdraw your consent at any time where processing is based on consent (without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to withdrawal).

To exercise any of the foregoing rights, please contact us using the information set out in Article 11 below. We will respond to your request within the timeframe required by applicable law.

Article 9 — Minors

The Website is not designed for individuals under the age of eighteen (18), and we do not intentionally collect personal information from minors. If you believe that we have inadvertently collected personal information from a minor, please contact us immediately and we will delete such information.

Article 10 — Amendments to This Notice

This Privacy Notice may be amended by us at any time. The revised version will be posted on the Website and shall take effect as of the date of posting. We encourage you to review this Notice periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.

Article 11 — Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Notice or wish to exercise your rights with respect to your personal information, please contact:
